name: europe-news-digest
description: European news digest with comprehensive sources across West, East, North and South

steps.name: fetch-uk-ireland
steps.prompt:
Fetch UK and Ireland news. Fetch ALL feeds in PARALLEL.

🇬🇧 UK Sources:
- BBC News: https://feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml
- The Guardian: https://feeds.theguardian.com/theguardian/rss
- Reuters UK: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/UKdomesticNews
- The Independent: https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/rss
- Sky News: https://news.sky.com/feeds/rss/home.xml (check)

🇮🇪 Ireland Sources:
- Irish Times: https://www.irishtimes.com/rss/top-stories.xml
- RTE News: https://www.rte.ie/news/rss/news-headlines.xml (check)

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously. Skip any >15s. No retries.

Extract top 5-7 recent stories per source with headline and summary.

Return structured list.

steps.name: fetch-western-europe
steps.prompt:
Fetch Western Europe news. Fetch ALL feeds in PARALLEL.

🇩🇪 Germany:
- Deutsche Welle: https://rss.dw.com/rdf/rss-en-all
- The Local Germany: https://www.thelocal.de/feeds/rss.xml
- Deutsche Welle Europe: https://rss.dw.com/rdf/rss-en-eu

🇫🇷 France:
- France 24: https://www.france24.com/en/rss
- The Local France: https://www.thelocal.fr/feeds/rss.xml
- France 24 Europe: https://www.france24.com/en/europe/rss

🇳🇱 Netherlands:
- DutchNews.nl: https://dutchnews.nl/feed/
- NL Times: https://nltimes.nl/feed (check)

🇧🇪 Belgium:
- Brussels Times: https://www.brusselstimes.com/feed/
- The Brussels Times EU: https://www.brusselstimes.com/eu/feed/

🇱🇺 Luxembourg:
- Luxembourg Times (check feed)

🇪🇸 Spain:
- El Pais English: https://english.elpais.com/rss feeds (check)
- The Local Spain: https://www.thelocal.es/feeds/rss.xml

🇮🇹 Italy:
- The Local Italy: https://www.thelocal.it/feeds/rss.xml
- Wanted in Rome (check)

🇵🇹 Portugal:
- The Portugal News: https://www.theportugalnews.com/rss.xml (check)

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously. Skip any >15s. No retries.

Extract top 3-5 stories per country.

Return structured list with country flags.

steps.name: fetch-nordics
steps.prompt:
Fetch Nordic region news. Fetch ALL feeds in PARALLEL.

🇳🇴 Norway:
- NRK: https://www.nrk.no/toppsaker.rss (Norwegian)
- The Local Norway: https://www.thelocal.no/feeds/rss.xml (English)

🇸🇪 Sweden:
- The Local Sweden: https://www.thelocal.se/feeds/rss.xml (English)
- Sveriges Radio (check English feed)

🇫🇮 Finland:
- Yle News: https://feeds.yle.fi/uutiset/v1/majorHeadlines/YLE_UUTISET.rss (English)
- News Now Finland: https://newsnowfinland.com/feed/ (English)

🇩🇰 Denmark:
- The Local Denmark: https://www.thelocal.dk/feeds/rss.xml (English)
- Copenhagen Post (check)

🇮🇸 Iceland:
- Iceland Review: https://icelandreview.com/feed/
- Reykjavik Grapevine (check)

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously. Skip any >15s. No retries.

Extract top 2-3 recent stories per Nordic country.

Note: Some sources are in local language - extract what you can.

Return structured list.

steps.name: fetch-eastern-europe
steps.prompt:
Fetch Eastern and Central Europe news. Fetch ALL feeds in PARALLEL.

🇵🇱 Poland:
- Notes from Poland: https://notesfrompoland.com/feed/ (English)
- Warsaw Business Journal (check)
- Polish News (check)

🇺🇦 Ukraine:
- Kyiv Independent: https://kyivindependent.com/feed/ (English)
- Ukraine Pravda English (check)
- Ukraine World (check)

🇷🇺 Russia (Western perspective):
- Moscow Times: https://www.themoscowtimes.com/rss/news (Independent, English)

🇨🇿 Czech Republic:
- Prague Morning (check)
- Radio Prague (check)

🇸🇰 Slovakia:
- Slovak Spectator (check)

🇭🇺 Hungary:
- Hungary Today (check)
- Daily News Hungary (check)

🇷🇴 Romania:
- Romania Insider (check)
- Bucharest Herald (check)

🇧🇬 Bulgaria:
- Sofia Globe (check)

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously. Skip any >15s. No retries.

Extract top 2-3 stories per source focusing on significant developments.

Return structured list noting independent English-language sources.

steps.name: format-europe-digest
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive European News Digest.

UK & IRELAND:
{{uk_ireland}}

WESTERN EUROPE:
{{western_europe}}

NORDICS:
{{nordics}}

EASTERN EUROPE:
{{eastern_europe}}

FORMAT:
```
🇪🇺 **Europe News Digest — {date}**

**🇬🇧 United Kingdom & 🇮🇪 Ireland**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source: BBC/Guardian/Irish Times)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**🇩🇪 Germany, 🇫🇷 France, Benelux**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Country flag + Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Country flag + Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Country flag + Source)*

**🇪🇸 Spain & 🇮🇹 Italy**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**🇳🇴 Norway, 🇸🇪 Sweden, 🇫🇮 Finland, 🇩🇰 Denmark, 🇮🇸 Iceland**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Nordic source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Nordic source)*

**🇵🇱 Poland, 🇺🇦 Ukraine, Eastern Europe**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**📊 Europe Brief**
Key themes across the continent:
• [EU policy/regulation theme]
• [Cross-border issue]

_Covering 20+ European nations — OpenFang Europe_
```

Select most significant pan-European stories. Keep under 2000 characters. Include country flags (🇬🇧🇮🇪🇩🇪🇫🇷🇳🇱🇧🇪🇱🇺🇪🇸🇮🇹🇵🇹🇳🇴🇸🇪🇫🇮🇩🇰🇮🇸🇵🇱🇺🇦🇨🇿🇸🇰🇭🇺🇷🇴🇧🇬).
